author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC11B10.07c
https://www.yeastgenome.org/locus/S000005267 (although this has flippas/floppase annotation)
the description states
Membrane protein of the plasma membrane and ER; interacts specifically in vivo with the phospholipid translocase (flippase) Dnf1p;

This  doesn't appear to be the flippase subunit, its a regulatory subunit

This seems like a key paper
https://elifesciences.org/articles/62163?

title: PAINT issue: GO:0015247	 aminophospholipid flippase activity IBA with Q9NV96 , PTN000100868 , Q3MIR4

author: marcfeuermann
body:
From the literature it is indeed not a flippase activity. It looks to be a substrate adaptor rather than a regulator.
I updated the annotation.
